summary: The biggest gap is source file coverage at 49.74% — half the codebase (the infrastructure_files cone containing celery/app/base.py, celery/canvas.py, celery/result.py, celery/worker/request.py, and ~70 other core files) was never documented. This is the #1 fix: create an infrastructure DETAIL.md. The second gap is the Agent's systematic disregard for explicit Skill instructions: despite 4 bold warnings in the Skill docs, Japanese 依赖関係 was used in ~12/24 DETAIL files; despite explicit Phase 4 renaming instructions with examples, non-functional module names (Azureblockblob, Gcs, Celery, Asynpool) remain. The Skill documentation itself is correct and complete — all failures are Agent execution errors, not Skill defects. Fix order: (1) create infrastructure module to push coverage above 80%, (2) fix character encoding across all DETAIL files, (3) rename module headings in INDEX.md.
